notes.title: Changelog-20240930
notes.notes: Change ironman score format, esp. for Arabic.

notes.title: Changelog-20240920
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Add Arabic support.
[*]Change button icons.
[/list]
The right arrow icon may be misinterpreted in Arabic as going back instead of going next.

notes.title: Changelog-20240915
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Upgrade the game engine to Godot 4.3.
[*]Reduce the penalty for game failure.
[*]Minor improvements to the user interface.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog 20240117
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Add buttons to save and load PBN files, and delete the copy button.
[*]Update button icons.
[*]Change the text color to red in night mode.
[/list]
After upgrading the game engine to Godot 4.3+, the price of this game will increase.

notes.title: Changelog 20240110
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add Spanish support.
[*] Update hotkeys.
[*] Change ironman mode to be auto effective when score >= 500.
[*] Fix leaderboard update problem.
[/list]
Two records in the ironman leaderboard are removed due to the bug.

notes.title: Changelog 20231219
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fix Danish support.
[*]Score will not be uploaded if not received from Steam.
[*]Set focus to Go button after Copy button pressed.
[/list]
